diagnosis.suspected_cause: The most likely cause of the load-generator failures is its "user_ask_agent" task. It POSTs to http://agent:8010/prompt, and the hostname "agent" does not resolve (NameResolutionError). Each call fails after about 4s. This looks like a missing or misconfigured "agent" dependency or load-generator target. A smaller, separate fault is the ad service's intermittent gRPC UNAVAILABLE on GetAds (~5% errors), which shows up as HTTP 500s on /api/data through frontend-proxy and frontend-web.
alternatives: The ad service's UNAVAILABLE errors as the main cause. This seems less likely, because they are only ~5% of ad traffic and show up as small error rates at frontend and frontend-proxy.
Kafka memory pressure causing the accounting consume errors. Kafka's memory trend is flat to falling, and this is unproven.
Opensearch or astronomy-db resource problems. I couldn't follow up on either, so this is unchecked.
diagnosis.uncertainty: Only 2 of 40 sampled traces showed the agent DNS failure, so I haven't shown it accounts for the full ~20% fail ratio. Part of the rest is probably the ad errors. Every container started about 3 minutes ago, so I have no pre-restart baseline. The ad memory growth of 50% is probably warm-up. Kafka sits at ~86% of its memory limit with a flat-to-falling trend. It showed no request or error metrics, and its CPU is low. I treat it as probably unrelated, but I can't rule out a link to the accounting Kafka "Consume error". For opensearch and astronomy-db, my follow-up calls failed because the tool budget ran out. I only have their resource_overview flags (opensearch 86% memory, astronomy-db memory growth of 21%). I did not check either one, so they remain unverified and are not ruled out. The accounting service reports no container metrics, so I couldn't check its resources. Its 15s p95 and 4% errors are unexplained, apart from one Consume error log. The data is live, not from the historical incident window. [Unresolved resource anomaly without follow-up evidence: opensearch, astronomy-db.]
diagnosis.next_step: Confirm whether an "agent" service is meant to be deployed and why DNS for host "agent" fails. Check the load-generator config for its agent endpoint. Then investigate why ad's GetAds returns UNAVAILABLE. Check opensearch and astronomy-db health, and the accounting-to-Kafka consume error.
